sloka: येन इयम् आगता द्वैधम् तव बुद्धिर् मही पते ।स हि धर्मः मम द्वेष्यः प्रसन्गात् यस्य मुह्यसि ॥२-२३-११॥
transliteration: yena iyam āgatā dvaidham tava buddhir mahī pate ।sa hi dharmaḥ mama dveṣyaḥ prasangāt yasya muhyasi ॥2-23-11॥

translations.english: O noble minded one I hate this righteousness which has deluded your intellect and created this dilemma about this issue.
